profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Java · Spring Boot · React · AWS | Healthcare Data (HL7 FHIR) & Payments | AI Integration
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years building cloud-native systems in Java, Spring Boot, React, and AWS.

At EPAM Systems, on the Cigna account, I architect microservices and Kafka + AWS HealthLake pipelines that standardize millions of clinical events into HL7 FHIR, and I lead architecture decisions across backend, data engineering, and DevOps teams. Our validation engines cut production errors by more than 30%.

Before that, on the Expedia account, I built the GraphQL and REST Experience APIs behind global KYC and tax flows and delivered backend automation that saved about $1.2M USD in operational costs.

Outside of client work I ship full products end to end: a bilingual React/TypeScript platform on AWS for Tec de Monterrey's startup ecosystem, and an operations app with an AI assistant built on Amazon Bedrock Agents. I build with Claude Code and hold Anthropic's Claude Certified Architect – Foundations credential.

Java · Spring Boot · React · TypeScript · AWS · Kafka · PostgreSQL · GraphQL · HL7 FHIR · Docker · Kubernetes · Terraform
